title: Mep Engineer
description:
Responsible for coordinating, monitoring and supervising Mechanical, Electrical and Plumbing (MEP) services for large-scale IT park/commercial building projects, ensuring that all MEP works are executed safely, on schedule, and in accordance with approved drawings, specifications, project standards and quality requirements. Key Responsibilities 1. MEP Coordination Coordinate HVAC, electrical, plumbing, firefighting and ELV services with civil, structural, architectural and interior works. Review MEP layouts, GFC/shop drawings, specifications and BOQs before execution. Identify and resolve service clashes and interface issues to minimize rework. Coordinate service routing, ceiling spaces, shafts, plant rooms and equipment areas. Conduct regular coordination meetings with contractors, subcontractors, consultants and project teams. 2. Site Execution & Supervision Monitor day-to-day MEP installation activities and ensure execution as per approved drawings and specifications. Supervise HVAC, ducting, piping, electrical containment, cabling, plumbing, drainage, firefighting and related MEP works. Check workmanship, installation quality, levels, alignment, supports and accessibility for maintenance. Identify site constraints and provide practical engineering solutions. 3. Drawing & Technical Coordination Review and coordinate GFC, shop drawings, builders-work drawings and as-built drawings. Check technical submittals, material approvals, method statements and installation procedures. Raise and follow up RFIs/TQs for design clarifications. Coordinate revisions arising from site conditions and client/consultant comments. Ensure the latest approved drawings are available at site. 4. HVAC Coordination Coordinate AHU, FCU, VRF/VRV, ventilation and exhaust systems. Coordinate ductwork, chilled-water/refrigerant piping, insulation, supports and equipment installation. Verify equipment locations, service clearances and maintenance access. Coordinate HVAC works with electrical, fire-fighting, plumbing, ceiling and architectural requirements. 5. Electrical & ELV Coordination Coordinate cable trays, trunking, conduits, busducts and electrical equipment. Coordinate electrical power, lighting, DBs, panels, UPS and related systems. Interface with ELV systems such as fire alarm, CCTV, access control, BMS, data/ICT and other building systems as applicable. Ensure proper coordination between electrical services and other MEP systems. 6. Plumbing & Fire Protection Coordination Coordinate domestic water supply, drainage, sanitary, rainwater and related plumbing services. Coordinate fire-fighting piping, pumps, hydrants, sprinklers and associated services. Ensure proper routing, slopes, supports, access and maintenance clearances. 7. Quality Control & Inspection Conduct regular inspections of MEP installations. Verify materials against approved specifications and material submittals. Prepare/coordinate inspection requests and obtain consultant/client approvals. Identify defects and ensure timely rectification. Maintain inspection records, checklists and snag lists. 8. Testing & Commissioning Coordinate testing and commissioning of HVAC, electrical, plumbing, firefighting and ELV systems. Witness and document testing activities as required. Coordinate TAB activities for HVAC systems where applicable. Ensure all commissioning records and test certificates are properly maintained. Support final snagging, system demonstrations and project handover. 9. Progress & Contractor Management Monitor daily and weekly MEP progress against the project programme. Coordinate manpower, materials, equipment and work fronts with subcontractors. Follow up material deliveries and ensure materials are properly stored. Monitor subcontractor productivity and workmanship. Highlight delays, constraints and potential programme impacts to the Project Manager. 10. Safety Ensure MEP activities comply with project HSE requirements. Coordinate safe working practices, permits, work-at-height requirements and PPE compliance. Participate in toolbox meetings and site safety inspections. Ensure proper housekeeping and safe storage of MEP materials. 11. Documentation & Reporting Prepare daily/weekly MEP progress reports. Maintain drawing registers, RFI/TQ registers, inspection records and material approval status. Maintain snag lists and monitor closure. Coordinate preparation and submission of as-built drawings, O&M manuals, test reports and commissioning documents. Assist in monthly progress measurement and contractor billing verification where required. Required Skills & Experience Diploma/B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical, Electrical or related Engineering discipline. Relevant experience in large-scale commercial/IT park projects preferred. Good knowledge of HVAC, electrical, plumbing, firefighting and ELV coordination. Ability to read and interpret MEP drawings and specifications. Knowledge of AutoCAD; Revit/Navisworks knowledge is an advantage. Good understanding of site execution, testing and commissioning. Strong coordination and communication skills. Ability to coordinate multiple subcontractors and disciplines simultaneously. Good knowledge of quality and safety requirements. Preferred Project Experience Experience in the following types of projects will be an advantage: IT Parks / Data Centres Commercial Buildings SEZ Projects High-rise Buildings Office Campuses Industrial Buildings Large-scale HVAC and MEP projects Key Performance Areas (KPIs) MEP work completed as per project schedule Reduction of service clashes and rework Quality of MEP installation Timely closure of inspections and RFIs Contractor/subcontractor coordination Testing & commissioning completion Snag-free handover Safety compliance Accuracy and timely submission of MEP documentation Benefits: Cell phone reimbursement Paid time off Petrol allowan ce

description:
The Apollo Hospitals Family Set-up in 1983 by Dr. Prathap C. Reddy, renowned as the architect of modern healthcare in India. As the nations first corporate hospital, Apollo Hospitals is acclaimed for pioneering the private healthcare revolution in the country. Apollo Hospitals has emerged as Asia’s foremost integrated healthcare services provider and has a robust presence across the healthcare ecosystem, including Hospitals, Pharmacies, Primary Care & Diagnostic Clinics and several retail health models. The cornerstones of Apollo’s legacy are its unstinting focus on clinical excellence, affordable costs, modern technology and forward-looking research & academics. 
 Role Description The Site Reliability Engineer is responsible for proactively monitoring, diagnosing and resolving production issues across Apollo's clinical, revenue and enterprise applications running across 50+ hospitals. Operating in a three-shift plus reliever model to provide 24x7 coverage, the SRE ensures that defined SLIs/SLOs are met, error budgets are governed, and permanent fixes are driven upstream into engineering. The role requires balancing reactive incident response with proactive reliability engineering — automating runbooks, tuning observability, and participating in chaos and disaster recovery drills. 
 Detailed Job Responsibility & Accountabilities Operate production monitoring consoles (Dynatrace, Azure Monitor, Log Analytics) during assigned shift and proactively detect anomalies before user impact. Triage and respond to Sev-1, Sev-2 and Sev-3 incidents per defined SLAs; coordinate with application, infrastructure, network, database and vendor teams for resolution. Execute documented runbooks for common failure modes and continuously improve/automate them. Participate in incident command during major outages; own communication updates to clinical and business stakeholders during critical events. Perform blameless postmortems for Sev-1/Sev-2 incidents and drive corrective actions to closure. Instrument new services with golden signals, custom metrics, distributed tracing and meaningful alerting. Identify and eliminate toil through scripting, automation and self-service tooling. Participate in chaos engineering, game-days and DR drills for clinical platforms. Maintain on-call readiness, escalation paths and shift handover quality; publish shift summary reports. Contribute to reliability scorecards, error budget tracking and availability reports for leadership. Support release readiness reviews and post-deployment verification for high-risk changes. 
 Desired Skills & Competencies Must have 4+ years of experience in SRE, production support engineering or DevOps with incident response exposure. Must have hands-on experience with observability tools such as Dynatrace, Prometheus/Grafana, ELK, Splunk, Azure Monitor. Must have strong Linux/Windows troubleshooting, networking fundamentals, and database (SQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB) query skills. Must have scripting proficiency in Python, PowerShell, Bash. Must have working knowledge of Kubernetes, Docker, Azure cloud services. Must have exposure to ticketing (ServiceNow, Jira), alerting (PagerDuty, Opsgenie) and communication discipline during incidents. Preferred exposure to SLO engineering and error budget practice. Comfort with rotating shift schedules (3-shift + reliever model) is essential. 
 Job Performance Parameters SLA adherence for incident acknowledgement, triage and resolution % incidents detected proactively before user impact during own shift MTTR contribution and number of permanent fixes raised to engineering Toil reduction through automation (hours saved/quarter) Shift handover quality and runbook compliance Postmortem action closure rate

title: Quality Engineer
description:
Quality Engineer: Fabrication & Heavy Engineering 
 Department: Quality Assurance / Quality Control
 Function: Fabrication & Heavy Engineering Production
 Designation: Quality Engineer
 Reporting To: Quality Manager / Plant Head
 Location: Manufacturing Unit
 Experience: 3 - 7 Years
 Qualification: Diploma / B.E. / B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering / Production Engineering 
 Job Purpose: The Quality Engineer will be responsible for ensuring that all fabrication, welding, machining, assembly and structural manufacturing activities are carried out in accordance with approved drawings, specifications, Quality Plans, ITPs and applicable standards. The role will work closely with Production, Engineering, PPC, Projects and Supply Chain teams to prevent quality issues, minimize rework and rejection, and ensure timely inspection and clearance of fabricated components and assemblies. 
 Key Roles & Responsibilities: 1. Fabrication & Production Quality Carry out stage-wise and final inspection of fabricated components, structures and assemblies. Ensure fabrication is carried out as per approved engineering drawings, BOM, specifications and customer requirements . Inspect material cutting, fit-up, welding, drilling, bending, machining, assembly and finishing activities. Verify critical dimensions, tolerances, alignment, straightness, squareness, flatness and overall geometry. Ensure proper identification and traceability of raw materials and fabricated components. Monitor production processes to identify and prevent potential quality deviations. 2. Welding Quality Perform inspection of joint preparation, fit-up, root gap, weld size, weld profile and finished welds . Ensure welding activities are performed according to approved WPS/PQR and qualified welder requirements , wherever applicable. Verify welding consumables, storage conditions and usage controls. Conduct visual inspection of weld joints and coordinate required NDT activities. Identify welding defects and coordinate corrective action with Production. Maintain welding and inspection records as per project/customer requirements. 3. Dimensional & Final Inspection Perform dimensional inspections using instruments such as: Vernier calipers Micrometers Height gauges Measuring tapes Weld gauges Spirit levels Other relevant inspection instruments Ensure measuring instruments are within valid calibration status. Conduct final inspection before surface treatment, painting, assembly, packing and dispatch. Ensure all identified observations are closed before final product clearance. 4. Quality Documentation Prepare and maintain: Inspection reports Dimensional inspection reports Stage inspection records Quality check sheets ITP/QAP records NCR reports Rework/rejection records NDT reports Calibration records Final quality dossiers, wherever applicable Ensure proper documentation and traceability for customer and third-party inspections. 5. NCR, Rejection & Rework Control Raise Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs) for deviations from drawings, specifications or processes. Coordinate with Production and Engineering teams for disposition and closure of NCRs. Monitor rejection, rework and repair trends . Conduct root cause analysis for recurring quality defects. Support implementation of corrective and preventive actions using tools such as 5 Why, Fishbone Analysis and CAPA . Drive reduction in Cost of Poor Quality through process improvement. 6. Engineering & Drawing Coordination Review fabrication drawings and understand GD&T, dimensions, tolerances, welding symbols and fabrication requirements . Highlight discrepancies or manufacturing concerns to the Engineering team before production. Ensure latest approved drawings and revisions are being followed on the shop floor. Coordinate technical clarification between Engineering, Production and Quality . 7. Production Quality Improvement Conduct regular shop-floor quality audits. Identify process gaps and recommend preventive quality controls. Participate in first-piece and first-off inspections for new components/products. Support development of inspection checkpoints for critical fabrication processes. Train and guide production supervisors, welders, fitters and operators regarding quality requirements and common defects. Promote a Right First Time quality culture in fabrication. 8. Customer / Third-Party Inspection Coordinate customer and Third-Party Inspection activities as required. Ensure products are internally inspected and cleared before offering them for customer/TPI inspection. Prepare required inspection documents and reports. Coordinate closure of inspection observations and punch points. 
 Key Performance Indicators KPIs Reduction in rejection and rework percentage First Pass Yield / Right First Time performance Number of internal and customer NCRs Timely closure of NCRs Customer inspection acceptance rate Adherence to inspection schedules Reduction in repeat quality issues Calibration compliance Quality documentation accuracy and completeness Reduction in Cost of Poor Quality Timely clearance of material without impacting production schedules 
 Technical Knowledge Required Candidate should have good knowledge of: Heavy engineering and structural fabrication Fabrication drawings and engineering drawings Welding processes such as SMAW, GMAW/MIG, GTAW/TIG and SAW , as relevant to the plant Welding symbols and weld inspection WPS, PQR and welder qualification concepts NDT methods such as VT, PT, MT, UT and RT Dimensional inspection techniques Measuring and inspection instruments GD&T fundamentals Material identification and traceability Surface preparation and painting inspection basics NCR/CAPA and Root Cause Analysis ISO-based Quality Management Systems 5S and continuous improvement practices 
 Preferred Skills Strong understanding of fabrication and welding quality Ability to read and independently interpret complex engineering drawings Strong shop-floor problem-solving abilities Good coordination with Production and Engineering personnel Ability to identify defects and recommend practical corrective actions Good documentation and report-writing skills Working knowledge of MS Excel, ERP/SAP and quality documentation systems Ability to work under production and dispatch timelines without compromising quality requirements 
 Desired Candidate Profile We are looking for a hands-on Quality Engineer with strong exposure to fabrication and heavy engineering manufacturing. The candidate should be capable of independently handling shop-floor inspections, welding quality, dimensional inspection, NCR management, quality documentation and final product clearance . The individual should work proactively with Engineering and Production teams to prevent defects rather than only identifying defects after production . 
 Preferred Experience Candidates with experience in manufacturing of any of the following will be preferred: Heavy fabricated structures Structural steel fabrication Gantries and road furniture structures FOB structures Telecom / infrastructure structures Defence fabrication Large welded assemblies Industrial equipment and engineered-to-order products

description:

Strategic Leadership & Planning:

Oversee resource utilization (materials, labor, machinery) to ensure optimal cost-effectiveness.

Negotiate with suppliers and manage vendor relationships to secure favorable terms for production inputs.

Timely Delivery & Supply Chain Coordination:

Team Leadership & Development:

description:

The incumbent will ensure all electrical and instrumentation systems are designed, engineered, and executed in compliance with project requirements, statutory norms, safety standards, and industry best practices. Detailed Engineering Manage the development and review of all discipline-specific engineering deliverables including: Single Line Diagrams (SLDs) Cable Schedules Load Lists Equipment Specifications & Datasheets Control & Instrumentation Layouts Loop Diagrams Cause & Effect Diagrams Hook-up drawings Ensure E&I designs comply with functional, process, and performance requirements. Control valves, Shutdown valves, Blowdown and safety systems. HT & LT Cables, junction boxes, control panels. Support technical bid evaluations, vendor selection, and engineering clarifications. Coordinate FATs, inspections, and quality checks with vendors. Define control logic, alarm philosophy, interlock design, and functional safety (SIL) assessments in line with IEC 61511. 4. Installation, Testing & Commissioning Provide technical oversight during installation and commissioning of E&I systems. Resolve site engineering issues and ensure adherence to approved drawings and standards. Support SAT, loop checking, control logic testing, and system energization. 5. Participate in design reviews, HAZOP, SIL studies, model reviews, and constructability assessments. Provide technical support for resolving interdisciplinary issues. 7. Project Controls & Documentation Identify E&I deliverables and ensure timely preparation and submission. Track progress, highlight delays, and support corrective actions. Ensure strict adherence to quality standards, engineering processes, and project schedules. 8. Safety & Reliability Ensure electrical and instrumentation systems are designed for safe operation, reliability, and maintainability. title: Laboratory Manager, Rubber
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION: LABORATORY MANAGER Company: Stacwell Rubber Pvt. Ltd.
Location: KesnandWagholi, Pune, Maharashtra
Industry: Rubber Components Manufacturing – Aerospace, Defence, Navy, Railway, Oil & Gas, Nuclear, Healthcare, Food & Drinking Water, Chemical, and Renewable Energy
Department: Laboratory / R&D / Quality Assurance
Position: Laboratory Manager
Reports To: Plant Head / General Manager
Functional Coordination With: Quality Manager / Production Manager / Commercial Manager / Purchase Manager 1. JOB SUMMARY The laboratory manager will be responsible for leading the laboratory, rubber formulation, material testing, product qualification, and technical validation activities at Stacwell Rubber Pvt. Ltd. 2. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES A. Rubber Formulation & Compound Development Design, develop, and optimize rubber formulations based on customer requirements and application conditions. Develop new rubber compounds for aerospace, defense, railway, oil & gas, and other critical applications. Review customer specifications, drawings, technical requirements, and applicable standards before formulation development. Select appropriate polymers, fillers, plasticizers, curing systems, additives, and other ingredients. Develop formulations considering hardness, tensile strength, elongation, compression set, temperature resistance, aging, chemical resistance, and other application requirements. Conduct laboratory trials and compound optimization. Coordinate with production for scale-up of laboratory formulations to production batches. Maintain formulation records, revision history, and technical documentation. Support cost optimization without compromising required product performance. B. Laboratory Management Manage day-to-day laboratory operations and testing activities. Plan and prioritize laboratory testing based on production schedules, customer requirements, and development activities. Supervise laboratory technicians and technical staff. Ensure proper operation, maintenance, and availability of laboratory equipment. Maintain laboratory discipline, 5S, and workflow efficiency. Establish and maintain laboratory testing procedures and work instructions. Ensure proper identification, handling, storage, and traceability of samples. Ensure compliance with laboratory safety requirements. C. Rubber Material & Product Testing Raw rubber materials Chemicals and ingredients Rubber compounds Semi-finished products Finished rubber components O-rings, seals, gaskets, and other critical rubber products D. Quality Assurance & Compliance ISO 9001 AS9100 ISO/IEC 17025 NADCAP laboratory/customer requirements, where applicable ASTM standards ISO standards SAE standards DIN standards Indian Standards Customer-specific specifications and test methods E. Calibration & Laboratory Equipment Control Prepare and maintain the laboratory calibration plan. Ensure timely calibration of all measuring and testing equipment. Maintain calibration certificates and records. Coordinate preventive maintenance and servicing of laboratory equipment. Verify equipment functionality before use. Identify equipment requiring repair, replacement, or external calibration. Ensure no expired or out-of-calibration equipment is used for product acceptance testing. F. Documentation & Technical Reporting Certificate of Analysis (COA) Test reports Material approval reports Validation reports Compound development reports Qualification reports Laboratory records Calibration records Customer technical reports Audit documentation Test method documentation Formulation records Trial and development reports Ensure complete traceability of raw materials, formulations, batches, samples, and test results. G. Research & Development Develop new rubber compounds based on customer/application requirements. Conduct laboratory trials and validation testing. Optimize existing formulations for performance, quality, and cost. Study material performance and identify improvement opportunities. Support new product development activities. Coordinate with Production and Quality during product/process trials. Support transfer of approved formulations from laboratory to production. Maintain technical knowledge of new rubber materials, additives, and technologies. H. Customer & Product Qualification Support Understand customer technical specifications and testing requirements. Coordinate customer-specific testing and qualification programs. Support product approval and qualification activities. Participate in technical discussions with customers when required. Support PPAP, FAI, and other customer documentation requirements. Prepare technical evidence for customer approvals. Ensure customer-specific test methods are correctly implemented. I. Team Management & Development Lead and supervise laboratory personnel. Allocate daily laboratory activities. Monitor employee performance and discipline. Train laboratory personnel on testing methods, equipment, and safety. Develop technical competency of laboratory staff. Conduct skill-gap analysis and arrange technical training. Ensure adequate manpower coverage for laboratory activities. 3. REQUIRED TECHNICAL SKILLS Rubber formulation and compound design Natural and synthetic rubber systems Rubber chemicals and additives Vulcanization and curing systems Rubber mixing processes Open mill / two-roll mill operations Internal mixing process knowledge Rubber testing and characterization Product qualification and validation ASTM / ISO / SAE / DIN standards Aerospace rubber requirements Customer-specific specifications Calibration and laboratory management Root Cause Analysis CAPA FMEA SPC Problem-solving techniques Technical documentation and traceability 4. EDUCATIONAL Essential: B.E./B.Tech in any relevant discipline such as Rubber Technology / Rubber & Chemical Technology Polymer Engineering / Polymer Technology Chemical Engineering Mechanical Engineering 5. EXPERIENCE REQUIRED Assistant Lab Manager 5–8 years of relevant experience in: Rubber formulation Rubber testing Laboratory operations Compound development/product qualification Lab Manager 8–15 years of relevant experience in: Rubber formulation and design Rubber testing laboratory Compound development Product qualification and validation Technical customer support/laboratory/team management Candidates with strong experience in aerospace rubber, sealing products, and critical applications will be preferred. 6. PREFERRED INDUSTRY EXPERIENCE Experience in one or more of the following industries will be preferred: Aerospace rubber components Aviation sealing systems Defense rubber products Navy applications Railway rubber components Oil & gas sealing products Nuclear applications 7. AEROSPACE & CRITICAL INDUSTRY RESPONSIBILITIES For aerospace and other critical applications, the lab manager shall: Ensure compliance with applicable AS9100 requirements. Maintain complete material and product traceability. Support NADCAP and customer audit requirements where applicable. Maintain strict control of laboratory records and technical documentation. Ensure controlled handling of critical materials and samples. Support FAI and product qualification requirements. Ensure validation and qualification testing is completed as per approved specifications. Maintain appropriate revision control of customer specifications and test methods. Ensure contamination control and proper laboratory housekeeping. Support customer-specific requirements for aerospace and critical applications. 8. KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS (KPIs) Performance will be monitored through measurable indicators, including: Number of new rubber formulations developed. Number of formulations successfully qualified. First-time right laboratory testing. Laboratory test accuracy and reliability. On-time completion of testing and reports. Customer qualification success. Reduction in product rejection. Reduction in customer complaints. Calibration compliance. Laboratory audit compliance. Implementation of process/product improvements. Reduction in formulation development time. Successful transfer of laboratory formulations to production. Laboratory team skill development. Cost optimization through formulation improvement.

Key Skills: Rubber Technology,Formulation Development,Rubber Mixing,Rubber Compounding,Formulation,O ring,Vulcanization,Open mill

title: MRO (Maintenance, Repair & Overhaul) Manager
description:
Role & responsibilities Key Responsibilities A. MRO Facility Setup Lead the establishment of the MRO facility from concept to operational readiness. Responsibilities include: Develop the MRO business plan. Define MRO service scope. Identify required infrastructure. Prepare facility-layout requirements. Define workstations and maintenance bays. Identify tooling and test equipment. Define ESD-safe work areas where required. Establish battery handling/storage areas. Develop component-storage facilities. Establish quarantine and rejected-parts areas. Develop final inspection and testing areas. Establish documentation and records systems. Prepare the initial MRO equipment and infrastructure requirement list . 4. Drone Maintenance Develop preventive and scheduled maintenance programmes for UAV platforms. Maintenance activities may include: Airframe inspection Motor inspection Propeller inspection ESC inspection Flight-controller inspection GPS/navigation-system inspection Communication-system inspection Battery inspection Payload inspection Wiring inspection Connector inspection Firmware/software checks Sensor checks Structural inspection Fastener checks Calibration checks Pre-flight/post-flight inspection Develop maintenance schedules based on: Flight hours Flight cycles Calendar time Manufacturer recommendations Operating environment Mission profile Component condition 5. Repair & Troubleshooting Establish systematic fault-diagnosis and repair procedures. The MRO team should be capable of diagnosing: Electrical faults Electronic faults Communication failures Flight-controller faults GPS/navigation problems Motor/ESC failures Power-system failures Battery-related issues Sensor failures Payload faults Wiring/connectivity problems Software/firmware issues Structural damage Develop standard troubleshooting procedures and diagnostic checklists. 6. Overhaul & Refurbishment Develop capabilities for overhaul and refurbishment of eligible drone systems and components. Activities may include: Complete system inspection Disassembly Component-level inspection Replacement of worn/damaged components Reassembly Calibration Functional testing Ground testing Flight testing where authorised and appropriate Final inspection Return-to-service documentation Maintain complete traceability of replaced components and maintenance activities. 7. Fleet Maintenance Develop fleet-maintenance programmes for institutional and commercial customers. Potential customers may include: Drone operators Survey companies Agriculture companies Infrastructure companies Mining companies Power companies Government agencies PSUs Industrial organisations Logistics companies Drone service providers Develop customer-specific: Maintenance schedules AMC packages Service-level agreements Spare-parts programmes Inspection schedules Fleet-health reports 8. Warranty & After-Sales Support Coordinate closely with the manufacturing and customer-support teams for: Warranty claims Technical complaints Field failures Product recalls, where applicable Component replacement Repair turnaround Customer communication Root-cause analysis Develop a structured Failure Reporting, Analysis and Corrective Action System . 9. MRO Quality System Establish a robust quality-management system for all MRO activities. Develop: SOPs Maintenance manuals Inspection checklists Repair procedures Quality inspection procedures Calibration procedures Tool-control procedures Component traceability Non-conformance procedures Corrective-action procedures Final inspection procedures Release documentation All maintenance activities must be performed within the applicable regulatory, manufacturer and organisational requirements. 10. Regulatory & Compliance Maintain awareness of applicable Indian aviation/drone regulations and ensure that MRO activities are undertaken only within the organisation's permitted scope. The MRO Head will coordinate with the company's regulatory/compliance function regarding applicable requirements of: Directorate General of Civil Aviation (DGCA) Ministry of Civil Aviation Applicable Drone Rules/regulations Applicable UAS-related requirements Manufacturer maintenance instructions Applicable safety requirements Environmental and workplace-safety requirements Where a particular maintenance, component or aircraft category requires a specific approval, authorisation, certification or licensed personnel, the MRO Head must ensure that the work is performed only by appropriately authorised personnel. 11. Spare Parts Management Establish a dedicated MRO spare-parts system. Manage: Critical spares Fast-moving components Consumables Repairable components Rotable components Batteries Motors ESCs Flight controllers GPS modules Sensors Propellers Connectors Wiring Electronic components Structural parts Develop: Minimum/maximum stock levels Reorder levels Supplier database Approved vendor list Part-number system Serial-number tracking Shelf-life tracking Component traceability 12. Tools & Test Equipment Identify and maintain appropriate: Electrical test equipment Multimeters Power analysers Battery analysers Soldering/rework equipment Electronic diagnostic equipment Motor/ESC testing equipment Calibration equipment Communication-test equipment Ground-test equipment Software diagnostic tools Drone-specific service tools Ensure appropriate calibration and tool-control records are maintained. 13. Battery Maintenance & Safety Develop specific procedures for UAV battery management, including: Inspection Charging Storage Health monitoring Capacity testing Cycle tracking Damage assessment Isolation of damaged batteries Disposal/recycling coordination Battery safety should be treated as a critical MRO function, particularly for lithium-based systems. 14. Technical Documentation Establish a comprehensive documentation system covering: Aircraft/drone history Serial numbers Flight hours/cycles Maintenance history Repairs Component replacements Battery history Inspection records Test results Calibration records Warranty claims Defects Accident/damage reports Return-to-service records Develop a digital Drone Maintenance Management System as the operation scales. 15. Root Cause & Reliability Engineering Analyse recurring failures and identify improvement opportunities. Develop: Failure database Failure-rate analysis Root-cause analysis Reliability reports Corrective-action plans Preventive-action plans Work with the R&D and manufacturing teams to feed MRO findings back into product design. 
 16. MRO Business Development Work with the Business Development team to develop the commercial MRO business. Develop services such as: Annual Maintenance Contracts Comprehensive Maintenance Contracts Pay-per-service maintenance Fleet maintenance Component repair Battery-health services Inspection packages Refurbishment Emergency repair Field-support contracts Technical support packages OEM-authorised service, where applicable Identify third-party drone fleets that may require maintenance support. 17. MRO Pricing & Commercial Management Develop commercially viable pricing models for: Preventive maintenance Corrective maintenance Inspection Repair Overhaul Component replacement Labour Field service AMC CMC Emergency support Track: Cost per repair Labour hours Spare-parts consumption Turnaround time Gross margin Warranty cost Customer profitability 18. MRO Turnaround Time Establish measurable service levels. Indicative metrics may include: Initial inspection time Diagnosis time Repair turnaround time Spare-part availability Final testing time Customer delivery time 19. Develop a system for tracking: Aircraft Received Inspection Diagnosis Estimate Approval Repair Testing Quality Inspection Release Customer 
 20. Coordination with Manufacturing & R&D The MRO Manager will work closely with: Manufacturing Product reliability Assembly issues Component failures Production quality R&D Design improvements Failure analysis New component testing Product modifications Quality Non-conformances Inspection systems Corrective actions Procurement Spare parts Vendors Component availability Business Development AMC/CMC Customer requirements MRO contracts This integration will help establish a complete Drone Product Lifecycle Management System .

Technical Competencies The candidate should have strong practical knowledge of: UAV systems Airframes Motors ESCs Flight controllers GPS/navigation Communication systems Batteries Sensors Payloads Electronics Wiring Diagnostics Calibration Firmware/software Ground testing Flight testing Knowledge of multirotor, fixed-wing and VTOL platforms will be an advantage. 24. title: Travel Sales Executive
description:
Location: Gurgaon, Haryana
 Experience Required: 02 years
 Industry: Travel & Tourism
 Employment Type: Full Time, Permanent
 Work Location: In Person 
 About Us We are a growing travel company based in Gurgaon, providing B2B travel solutions to travel agents and travel professionals across India. Our B2B services include Visa Services, Hotels, Holiday Packages and other travel-related solutions designed to help travel agents serve their clients efficiently and competitively. 
 We are looking for a B2B Travel Sales & Agent Onboarding Executive who will be responsible for identifying potential travel agents, connecting with them through outbound calls, generating business leads, introducing our B2B services and onboarding new travel-agent partners. 
 This is an excellent opportunity for someone looking to build a career in B2B Travel Sales, Travel Agent Relationship Management and Business Development . 
 Job Description As a B2B Travel Sales & Agent Onboarding Executive, you will be responsible for developing our network of B2B travel-agent partners through calling, lead generation, follow-ups and relationship building . 
 You will regularly connect with travel agencies, independent travel agents, tour operators and other travel professionals to introduce our services and encourage them to register and transact with us. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 1. B2B Lead Generation Identify and generate leads for potential travel agents, tour operators and travel agencies through online research, databases, social media, directories and other sources. Build and maintain a database of prospective B2B travel partners. Identify agents who may have requirements for visas, hotels, holiday packages and other travel services . Continuously expand the company's B2B travel-agent network. 
 2. Outbound Calling Make regular outbound calls to prospective travel agents and introduce the company's B2B services. Understand the agent's business profile and identify their travel-service requirements. Explain our B2B Visa, Hotel and Holiday Package services clearly and professionally. Handle basic queries and coordinate with the concerned internal team for detailed requirements. Maintain a professional and positive approach during calls. 
 3. Agent Onboarding Convert interested travel agents into registered B2B partners. Explain the onboarding/registration process and assist agents in completing the required information and documentation. Follow up with interested agents until the onboarding process is completed. Ensure newly onboarded agents understand the available services and how to raise their requirements with our team. 
 4. Follow-Ups & Lead Conversion Regularly follow up with prospective and interested travel agents through phone, WhatsApp and email . Maintain proper records of calls, discussions, follow-ups and lead status. Reconnect with inactive or previously contacted agents to generate new opportunities. Work towards converting leads into active B2B travel-agent accounts. 
 5. B2B Relationship Building Develop professional relationships with travel agents and maintain regular communication. Understand agents' recurring requirements and communicate relevant products, offers and services. Share appropriate information about new visa services, hotel deals, packages and other B2B offerings. Coordinate with the sales and operations teams to ensure smooth handling of agent requirements. 
 6. CRM & Reporting Maintain accurate lead and agent information in the company's CRM/database. Update call outcomes, follow-up dates, onboarding status and business opportunities. Maintain daily activity reports covering calls, leads generated, follow-ups and onboardings. Ensure no qualified lead is missed due to inadequate follow-up. 
 7. Team Coordination Coordinate with the Visa, Hotels, Packages and Operations teams for agent requirements. Forward qualified enquiries to the relevant sales/operations team. Follow up internally to ensure that agent enquiries are addressed on time. Support the senior B2B sales team in converting opportunities into business. 
 Requirements 2–4 years of experience in sales, telecalling, business development, customer service or travel-related roles. Freshers with strong communication skills and an interest in the travel industry may also be considered. Prior experience in B2B sales, telecalling or travel-agent calling will be an advantage. Good verbal and written communication skills. Comfortable making a high volume of outbound calls. Confident speaking with travel agents and business owners over the phone. Basic understanding of travel, tourism, hotels, visas or holiday packages is preferred. Good follow-up and relationship-building skills. Comfortable using WhatsApp, email, Excel/Google Sheets and CRM software . Ability to maintain accurate lead records and follow a structured follow-up process. Target-oriented and motivated to achieve lead-generation and onboarding targets. Ability to work independently as well as part of a team. Must be based in Gurgaon/Gurugram or nearby and willing to work from the Gurgaon office. 
 Preferred Qualifications Graduate in any discipline. Diploma/Degree in Travel & Tourism, Hospitality, Business Management or a related field will be an advantage. Previous experience with a travel agency, tour operator, OTA, hotel company or visa consultancy is preferred. Existing familiarity with the travel-agent/B2B travel ecosystem will be an added advantage. 
 Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) The candidate will primarily be evaluated on: Number of qualified B2B travel-agent leads generated. Number of outbound calls and meaningful conversations. Number of follow-ups completed. Number of new travel agents onboarded. Number of newly onboarded agents becoming active. Enquiries/business generated from onboarded agents. Accuracy and regularity of CRM/database updates. Response and follow-up discipline. 
 What We Offer Competitive salary with performance-based incentives . Opportunity to earn incentives based on B2B lead generation, agent onboarding and business conversion . Exposure to Visa Services, Hotels, Holiday Packages and B2B Travel Sales . Opportunity to develop a strong network within the travel-agent community. Training and guidance on B2B travel products and services. Career growth opportunities within the B2B sales and travel business. Opportunity to work with a growing travel company and gain hands-on experience across multiple travel products. 
 Ideal Candidate We are looking for someone who is confident on the phone, energetic, persistent with follow-ups and comfortable speaking to new people every day . 
 The candidate should enjoy sales and relationship building and should be willing to make outbound calls, identify opportunities and convert interested travel agents into active B2B partners. If you are a fresher or have 0–2 years of experience and want to build your career in B2B Travel Sales, this role can provide a strong platform to learn and grow.

title: Human Resource Manager
description:
Job Purpose To provide full-spectrum HR support across assigned regions, including recruitment, onboarding, employee development, HR operations, and employee engagement, ensuring smooth HR functioning, local compliance, and effective coordination between regional teams and central HR. The Regional HR acts as the primary HR representative for all regional staff and ensures the implementation of HR policies, culture, and performance standards across zones. Key Responsibilities 1. Recruitment & Talent Acquisition (Regional Level) Manage end-to-end recruitment for regional roles across departments. Source candidates through job portals, consultants, references, and social media. Schedule and coordinate interviews with hiring managers & panel members. Conduct preliminary HR screening and culture-fit evaluations. Share offer letters, negotiate salaries within the defined structure, and ensure documentation compliance. 2. Onboarding & Induction Conduct onboarding for new joiners across the region. Ensure collection of mandatory documents and creation of employee files. Coordinate induction sessions for new hires. Ensure department-level training completion for all new joiners. 3. Employee Development & Engagement Identify skill gaps and coordinate with central L&D for training programs. Track training attendance and completion for regional employees. Conduct employee engagement activities (festivals, birthday celebrations, welfare programs). Gather employee feedback and ensure timely issue resolution. 4. HR Operations Support Maintain employee records, attendance, and leave data for the region. Ensure timely submission of regional HR reports to central HR. Ensure adherence to company policies, HR standards, and statutory compliance requirements. Support offboarding activities, including exit interviews, asset recovery, and clearance. 5. Regional Employee Support Serve as the first point of contact for employees regarding HR policies, claims, grievances, and benefits. Address employee concerns professionally and escalate critical cases to HR Head. 6. Cross-Functional Coordination Coordinate with departments such as Sales, CRM, Projects, Admin & Finance for manpower requirements and HR support. Liaise with the central HR for policy updates, circulars, and implementation.

title: Human Resource Manager
description:
About the Role: As HR Manager at EaseMyTrip.com , you will be responsible for driving and managing end-to-end human resource operations across the organization. From recruitment strategy and employee lifecycle management to performance systems, compliance, and employee engagementyou will oversee all critical HR functions. This leadership role demands strategic thinking, people management, and execution capabilities to foster a culture of performance, positivity, and growth. You will work closely with management to align HR strategies with business objectives while continuously improving processes and employee experience. 
 Key Responsibilities: HR Strategy & Systems Management: Develop and implement company-wide HR strategies, policies, and frameworks to support business growth and employee development. Leadership Collaboration: Regularly engage with senior management to assess talent needs and align HR practices with evolving organizational goals. Talent Acquisition & Recruitment: Oversee the entire recruitment lifecycle—including sourcing, screening, and onboarding—across technical and non-technical roles via internal and external channels. Employee Lifecycle Management: Ensure timely execution of employee documentation such as LOIs, appointment letters, confirmations, promotions, increments, and exit formalities. Onboarding & Induction: Lead the onboarding process for new employees, including induction programs, bank formalities, and statutory compliance setup. HRMS & Documentation: Manage employee data via HRMS software and maintain accurate records for personnel files, status changes, and statutory updates. Payroll & Attendance Administration: Supervise payroll processes, attendance tracking, and salary disbursements while ensuring adherence to labor laws and tax compliance. Employee Engagement & Culture: Design and implement innovative employee engagement and welfare initiatives that boost morale, productivity, and retention. Grievance Redressal & Compliance: Handle employee grievances, conduct exit interviews, enforce disciplinary actions, and maintain compliance with labor laws and internal policies. Performance & MIS Oversight: Manage the performance appraisal process and maintain periodic MIS reports related to HR operations, including staffing changes, exits, and transfers. 
 Preferred Candidate Profile Experience: Minimum 3 years of experience in an HR Manager or HR Business Partner role, preferably leading a team in a mid-to-large-sized organization. Educational Qualification: Postgraduate degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related discipline. People Management: Proven experience in managing HR teams and overseeing multi-functional HR operations. Communication Skills: Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to engage at all levels of the organization. Recruitment Expertise: Demonstrated ability in talent sourcing through job portals, LinkedIn, referrals, and headhunting. Presentation & Reporting: Proficient in preparing professional presentations and reports related to HR activities and KPIs. Problem-Solving Mindset: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to make data-driven HR decisions. Organizational Abilities: Highly organized, accurate, and thorough with a strong commitment to quality execution. Legal & Statutory Knowledge: Deep understanding of labor laws, PF, ESI, TDS, gratuity, and other payroll compliance requirements. Tech Proficiency: Skilled in MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word) and HRMS tools for data management and automation.

title: Consultant – Commercial  Analytics (Pharma)
description:
HCP-Level & Commercial Analytics
o
Lead HCP-level performance analytics: prescribing trends, market share dynamics, decile movement, and segment-level diagnostics for the brand.
o
Design and execute promotion response measurement for the brand — including model construction, assumption documentation, validation, and sensitivity analysis. Frame what the model can and cannot answer; do not over-claim.
o
Analyze market dynamics around the brand — competitive uptake, payer mix shifts, channel mix, and launch trajectory benchmarking against analog launches.
3.
Brand Performance Reporting & Diagnostics
o
Own the brand performance reporting layer for the Insights & Analytics team — weekly and monthly trackers, KPI dashboards, and the diagnostic deep-dives that explain what the trackers are showing.
o
Establish reporting SLAs, refresh calendars, validation checkpoints, and exception protocols. Every number that reaches the client should be traceable and defensible.
4.
Methodology & Data Management
o
Be the methodology owner for the analyses you lead — selection of approach, defensible documentation, peer review, and post-delivery learning capture.
o
Work fluently with the secondary data stack used on the account: IQVIA (Xponent, DDD, NPA), Komodo, Symphony, specialty pharmacy and hub data, payer/claims data, and Veeva CRM.
o
Read and challenge BRDs, source-to-target mappings, and business rule definitions critically. Catch issues upstream — in the spec — rather than in the dashboard. Experience o
5–8 years in pharma / life sciences analytics, with experience spanning both patient-level and HCP-level / commercial analytics for US biopharma clients.
o
Direct, hands-on experience at one of: ZS Associates, Axtria, IQVIA, Trinity, Cognizant Life Sciences, or an in-house Insights & Analytics team at a top-25 pharma company.
o
Demonstrated work on a launch or early in-line brand is strongly preferred; specialty therapy exposure (HIV/PrEP, oncology, rare disease, immunology) is a plus.
o
Comfortable operating alongside other analytics vendors on the same account — you will not be the only analytics partner in the room.
2.
Domain Expertise (US Pharma Commercial)
o
Working knowledge of patient journey analytics: cohort construction, persistence and adherence measurement, bridging logic, switching analysis, and the data limitations of each.
o
Working knowledge of HCP-level analytics: prescribing dynamics, market share decomposition, segmentation diagnostics, and promotion response measurement.
o
Fluency with the secondary data stack: IQVIA Xponent / DDD / NPA, Symphony, Komodo, specialty pharmacy and hub data, payer/claims data, and Veeva CRM.
o
Understanding of the launch analytics rhythm — what questions the brand team asks pre-launch, in early launch, and through steady state.
3.
Technical Skills
o
Strong SQL — complex joins, window functions, and performance-tuned queries on large healthcare datasets.
o
Python for analysis and modeling: pandas, scikit-learn, stats models; comfort building and validating models (regression, classification, survival, response-curve fitting).
o
Sound grounding in relational and dimensional data modeling — enough to read a BRD or mapping document critically, not necessarily to build the warehouse.
o
Proficiency in at least one BI platform (Power BI, Tableau, or Qlik) sufficient to design and review dashboards, not just author them.
o
Comfortable instituting QC discipline: writing validation scripts, designing reconciliation routines, and documenting business rules.
4.
Consulting & Communication
o
Able to lead a client conversation, not just present in one: frame the problem, walk through methodology, defend the recommendation, and adjust based on pushback.
o
Writes cleanly — methodology notes, BRDs, executive summaries, and slide narratives that hold up to scrutiny.
o
Comfortable disagreeing with a senior client constructively, and equally comfortable saying "we don't know yet, here is how we'll find out."

title: Event Management & Marketing Executive
company: Blue Data Consulting And It Services
description:
About the Organisation Blue Data Consulting is a technology consulting, capability-building and professional education company specialising in Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI, Analytics, Automation and emerging technologies. Through Blue Data Consulting, we work with enterprises, professionals, students, universities and technology communities to deliver corporate training programs, workshops, webinars, technology events and career-focused learning initiatives. 
 Role Overview We are looking for a hands-on and ownership-driven Event Management & Marketing Executive to manage webinars, podcasts, workshops, training programs, exhibitions, expos and community events. The person will take responsibility for the complete event lifecycle from planning and promotion to execution, participant engagement, lead capture and post-event reporting. This is an execution-focused role for someone who enjoys running events, coordinating multiple stakeholders and creating marketing campaigns that generate registrations, engagement, visibility and business opportunities. The successful candidate should be comfortable working independently, following up with speakers and vendors, managing event-day operations and ensuring that every event is delivered successfully. Key Responsibilities 1. Event Planning and Execution Develop and maintain a calendar of webinars, podcasts, workshops, training events, exhibitions and community programs. Convert event ideas into structured execution plans with objectives, timelines, budgets and responsibilities. Identify suitable dates, venues, speakers, trainers, partners and vendors. Prepare event checklists and monitor readiness across all workstreams. Coordinate internal teams, speakers, designers, vendors and external partners. Take ownership of event-day operations and resolve last-minute issues. Ensure that events are delivered on schedule, within budget and according to expected quality standards. Conduct post-event reviews and document recommendations for improvement. 2. Webinars and Virtual Events Identify relevant webinar topics related to AI, technology, analytics, automation, careers and professional education. Coordinate with speakers, moderators and subject-matter experts. Set up and manage webinars using Zoom, Microsoft Teams, Google Meet or similar platforms. Create registration forms and coordinate landing pages where required. Manage invitations, confirmations, reminders and participant communication. Conduct technical rehearsals and speaker briefings. Manage live sessions, including participant admission, moderation, polls, Q&A and recordings. Coordinate post-event communication, feedback collection and resource sharing. Track registrations, attendance, engagement, enquiries and qualified leads. 3. Podcasts and Video Interviews Identify suitable podcast guests from the technology, business, education and startup ecosystem. Reach out to potential guests and coordinate recording schedules. Research speakers and prepare discussion themes and interview questions. Coordinate studio, venue, audio, video, lighting and technical requirements. Manage both physical and virtual podcast recordings. Coordinate video editing, branding, thumbnails, captions and publishing. Repurpose podcast content into short videos, social-media posts, quotations and articles. Maintain a consistent podcast and video publishing calendar. Track views, engagement, watch time and enquiries generated. 4. Offline Workshops and Training Events Organise public workshops, corporate training programs, masterclasses and technology meetups. Coordinate venues, trainers, participants, event materials, certificates and refreshments. Manage registration desks and participant support during events. Coordinate audio-visual equipment, seating, signage, photography and videography. Ensure that trainers and speakers receive complete event information and support. Collect participant feedback and coordinate certificates and post-event resources. Support follow-up with prospective students, professionals and corporate participants. 5. Exhibitions, Expos and Conferences Identify relevant exhibitions, conferences and technology expos in Surat and other priority locations. Evaluate exhibitor, sponsorship and participation opportunities. Coordinate stall booking and communication with event organisers. Manage stall branding, banners, brochures, demonstrations and promotional materials. Coordinate staff schedules, travel, logistics and on-site operations. Develop pre-event, live-event and post-event promotional campaigns. Capture visitor information and categorise potential leads. Prepare post-event reports covering footfall, leads, expenditure and business opportunities. 6. Event Marketing and Campaign Management Develop a promotional plan for every event. Define the target audience, event message, channels and campaign timeline. Run campaigns through LinkedIn, email, WhatsApp and relevant online communities. Coordinate Instagram and Facebook promotions when relevant. Develop speaker-led and partner-led promotional campaigns. Coordinate outreach to colleges, companies, professional groups and local communities. Prepare clear content and design briefs for the support team. Review campaign creatives and ensure their timely publication. Monitor registrations and adjust campaigns where participation is below target. Support paid campaigns when approved. 7. Social-Media and Content Coordination Maintain an event-focused social-media content calendar. Prepare post concepts, captions, campaign messages and basic content drafts. Coordinate with graphic designers, video editors and the content team. Schedule or publish approved content across relevant platforms. Promote upcoming events, speakers, training programs, success stories and participant outcomes. Repurpose event recordings into social-media content. Monitor reach, impressions, engagement, clicks, registrations and enquiries. Recommend improvements based on campaign performance. 8. Partnerships and Community Outreach Build working relationships with colleges, universities, coworking spaces and professional communities. Engage with startup networks, technology communities, HR groups and L&D professionals. Develop relationships with local media, event organisers, speakers and influencers. Identify opportunities for joint events, community promotions and speaker exchanges. Coordinate with college training and placement departments. Support venue partnerships and audience-sharing arrangements. Maintain an updated database of potential partners, communities and speakers. 9. Lead Capture and Follow-Up Coordination Ensure that participant and visitor information is collected accurately. Categorise leads into students, professionals, corporate buyers, partners and speakers. Update the CRM or approved lead-tracking system. Share qualified leads with the relevant sales, admissions or counselling team. Coordinate post-event follow-up communication. Track enquiries and conversions generated through events. Ensure that participant information is handled responsibly and according to applicable privacy requirements. 10. Budget and Vendor Management Prepare event-level budget estimates. Obtain and compare quotations from venues and vendors. Coordinate with printers, photographers, videographers, caterers and production teams. Negotiate commercially reasonable rates and payment terms. Obtain internal approvals before confirming expenditure. Monitor planned versus actual event costs. Verify vendor deliverables before processing invoices. Maintain a reliable database of local venues and event-service providers. 
 Internal Support Available The selected candidate may receive support from internal or remote teams for: Graphic design Video editing Content development Landing-page development Technical subject-matter inputs Administrative coordination However, the candidate will remain responsible for preparing clear briefs, following up with support teams, maintaining timelines and ensuring successful final delivery. 
 Required Skills and Experience 36 years of relevant experience in event management, marketing, community management, education marketing or a related field. Demonstrated experience managing physical and virtual events. Working knowledge of digital marketing and social-media campaigns. Experience coordinating speakers, vendors, venues, partners and participants. Strong planning, organisation and follow-up capabilities. Ability to manage multiple events and deadlines simultaneously. Good written and verbal communication skills. Comfortable using LinkedIn, Canva, Google Workspace, WhatsApp Business, Zoom and similar tools. Basic understanding of campaign metrics, lead tracking and post-event reporting. Ability to work independently with limited supervision. Willingness to travel locally and occasionally to nearby cities. Willingness to support events during evenings or weekends when required. Fluency in English and Hindi; Gujarati proficiency would be an advantage. 
 Preferred Qualifications Experience in technology, Artificial Intelligence, EdTech, professional education or corporate training. Existing relationships with colleges, universities, professional communities or event partners in Surat. Experience managing webinars, podcasts or video-based content. Familiarity with CRM, email-marketing or marketing-automation platforms. Experience participating in exhibitions, expos or conferences. Basic copywriting, content-creation or Canva skills. 
 Desired Attributes We are looking for someone who is: Ownership-driven and dependable Highly organised and detail-oriented Energetic and comfortable interacting with people Proactive in following up with stakeholders Calm under pressure Resourceful when dealing with last-minute problems Comfortable with hands-on execution Focused on measurable outcomes Interested in AI, technology and professional education 
 Key Performance Indicators Performance may be assessed through: Number of successfully delivered events Timely and within-budget event execution Event registrations and attendance Registration-to-attendance conversion rate Cost per registration and qualified lead Participant feedback and satisfaction Qualified leads generated through events Event-generated enquiries and conversions Number of active community and institutional relationships Social-media reach and engagement Consistency of webinar, podcast and content publication Quality and timeliness of post-event reports Vendor performance and cost management 
 Important Role Expectations This is a hands-on role. The selected candidate must be comfortable: Taking end-to-end responsibility for events. Personally following up with speakers, vendors and internal teams. Conducting promotional outreach and campaign activities. Working from event venues when required. Handling last-minute operational issues. Working occasionally during evenings or weekends. Travelling locally and occasionally outside Surat. Being measured on registrations, attendance, engagement, leads and event outcomes. 
 Why Join Us? Work in the fast-growing AI, technology and professional education ecosystem. Lead diverse webinars, podcasts, training programs and offline events. Build relationships with industry leaders, universities, communities and technology professionals. Receive support from experienced design, content and technical teams. Gain significant ownership and an opportunity to grow into an events, community or marketing leadership role.

Key Skills: Social Media Marketing,Lead Generation,Campaign Management,Event Planning,Content Creation,Brand Promotion,Budget Management,Digital Marketing

title: Co-Founder (Chartered Accountant)- Bookxpert
description:
About Bookxpert: 
 Bookxpert is a technology-driven accounting company with a mission of "Empowering SMEs & Assisting Auditors." We provide end-to-end accounting, taxation, compliance, payroll, MIS, and financial management services through a tech-enabled, distributed service model. Our goal is to simplify business finance and become the most trusted accounting partner for SMEs and professionals. 
 Position Overview: 
 We are looking for a passionate, entrepreneurial, and execution-focused Chartered Accountant to join our founding team. As a Co-Founder, you will play a key role in driving business growth, strengthening operations, building customer relationships, leading teams, and representing Bookxpert in the market. This is an opportunity to build a scalable business and create a lasting impact. 
 Key Responsibilities: 
 Drive the company's vision, strategy, and business growth. Meet clients, understand their business needs, and present Bookxpert's services and solutions. Build and maintain strong relationships with customers, auditors, partners, and stakeholders. Develop and improve service delivery, SOPs, and operational processes. Lead, mentor, and build high-performing teams. Oversee day-to-day business operations and ensure service excellence. Monitor business performance, budgets, and key operational metrics. Support fundraising, investor relations, and strategic partnerships. Work closely with the Sales & Marketing team to acquire and retain customers. Represent Bookxpert at client meetings, business events, seminars, colleges, and networking forums. Build a professional presence through public speaking, LinkedIn, webinars, and social media to strengthen the Bookxpert brand. Travel as required for client meetings, business development, partnerships, and expansion initiatives. Drive innovation, continuous improvement, and business scalability. 
 Required Candidate Profile: 
 Chartered Accountant (CA) with 3+ years of post-qualification practice experience . Strong knowledge of Accounting, Taxation, Compliance, Audit, and Financial Advisory. Entrepreneurial mindset with a passion for building businesses. Excellent leadership, communication, presentation, and negotiation skills. Strong business development and client relationship management abilities. Confident in public speaking and representing the company professionally. Active or willing to build a professional presence on LinkedIn and other social media platforms. Strategic thinker with strong execution and problem-solving skills. Willingness to travel as per business requirements. Startup experience or fundraising exposure is an added advantage. 
 What We Offer: Significant equity ownership with a long-term wealth-creation opportunity. Opportunity to build and scale a high-growth startup from the ground up. Leadership role with direct influence on business strategy and key decisions. Exposure to investors, industry leaders, and strategic partnerships. Fast-paced, entrepreneurial, and innovation-driven work environment. Continuous learning, professional growth, and leadership development. Opportunity to create a meaningful impact by empowering thousands of SMEs and auditors.

 Note: Only candidates with experience in International Merchant Card Disputes and Chargebacks will be considered. 

 JOB DESCRIPTION FOR 2A: 
 Role Summary: Own end-to-end merchant dispute handling across Visa, Mastercard, American Express, and Discover, including chargeback, representment, pre-arbitration, and arbitration. Maximize recovery, ensure rule compliance, and deliver a strong merchant experience under network SLAs. 
 Key Responsibilities: 
 A. Dispute & Chargeback Lifecycle: Triage disputes (including retrievals/RFIs), validate reason codes, and decide action (accept/represent/pre-arb/arb). Prepare and file Compelling Evidence (CE) for representments within network/processor SLAs. Lead pre-arbitration negotiations; prepare arbitration submissions with accurate documentation and clear arguments. Track outcomes, escalate edge cases, reduce cycle times, and improve win/recovery rates. 
 B. Evidence & Documentation: Collect and package CE: transaction logs, AVS/CVV/3DS data, device/IP signals, delivery proof, customer communications, screenshots, T&Cs/cancellation policies, refund records, support transcripts. Maintain reason-code libraries and SOPs aligned to Visa Claims Resolution (VCR) and Mastercard Dispute Resolution (MDR); ensure documentation is audit-ready. 
 C. Merchant & Stakeholder Communication: Liaise with merchants, Customer Support, Risk, Finance, acquirers/processors, and external partners to gather data and resolve disputes promptly. Educate merchants on prevention (billing descriptors/testing, receipt design, refund policies, shipping/signature confirmation, post-purchase communications). 
 D. Compliance & Controls: Adhere to Visa/Mastercard/Amex/Discover rules and acquirer/processor guidelines; ensure evidence integrity and privacy compliance. Support monitoring programs (e.g., Visa VDMP/VFMP; Mastercard ECP) by supplying accurate dispute/fraud metrics. 
 E. Reporting & Continuous Improvement: Track KPIs: representment win rate, recovery dollars, TAT/cycle time, pre-arb avoidance, write-off reduction, dispute ratio health. Identify root causes and drive prevention playbooks (descriptor hygiene, friendly-fraud defenses, SCA/3DS optimization, logistics/signature policies). Contribute to automation/templates and quality reviews to enable First-Time-Right submissions. 
 Required Qualifications: 1 to 2 years in merchant disputes & chargebacks across Visa, Mastercard, Amex, Discover. Practical exposure to VCR/MDR workflows and phases (chargeback representment pre-arb arbitration). Experience drafting reason-code-specific narratives and assembling CE. Hands-on with VROL, Mastercom/Claims Manager, Amex/Discover portals; CRM/ticketing tools. Strong analytical and written skills; ability to interpret payment data/logs to build a defensible case. High ownership, urgency, and resilience under tight deadlines; willingness to work US hours onsite (no hybrid/remote). 
 Preferred Qualifications: Experience with acquirers/PSPs (e.g., Fiserv/First Data, Worldpay/FIS, TSYS, Adyen, Stripe) and tools like Ethoca/Verifi Order Insight. Knowledge of chargeback prevention best practices. Intermediate Excel/Sheets; basic SQL/BI a plus. Exposure to merchant education/training on prevention. Bachelors degree in Business/Finance/Accounting/Commerce. 
 JOB DESCRIPTION FOR 3A: 
 Role Summary: Serve as the domain expert for multi-brand dispute managementelevating win rates through evidence strategy, rule interpretation (VCR/MDR/Amex/Discover), and advanced escalationswhile coaching the floor and owning complex/high-value cases. 
 Key Responsibilities: 
 A. Complex Case Leadership: Own high-value/complex disputes end-to-end; optimize representment narratives and CE per reason code. Lead pre-arbitration strategies and arbitration submissions with precise arguments and artefacts. 
 B. Rule Interpretation & Governance: Interpret network rule changes; update SOPs/playbooks and roll out training/calibrations. Partner with acquirers/processors on policy clarifications and case-level negotiations. 
 C. Quality & Enablement: Review/approve critical submissions to ensure First-Time-Right quality; reduce rework/defects. Coach Agents; certify new hires for production; drive template/snippet/evidence-checklist improvements. 
 D. Prevention & Analytics: Identify friendly-fraud patterns and systemic gaps; recommend prevention (descriptor hygiene, refund/return design, SCA/3DS). Collaborate with Analytics/Automation to scale insights and reduce manual workload. 
 Required Qualifications: Deep knowledge of VCR/MDR, Amex & Discover procedures; strong case-law style writing. Hands-on with VROL, Mastercom, Amex/Discover portals; CRM; intermediate Excel; SQL/BI preferred. Proven track record improving win rates and reducing pre-arb volumes. 
 Documents to Carry: Carry a printout your updated resume. Carry any 2 photo Identity proof (PAN Card/Driving License/Voters ID card/Passport). All original education documents needs to be available for verification. (10th, 12th, Graduation (Sem Wise Marksheet, CMM. Provisional and Original Degree)

description:
Job Summary: Are you ready to take your engineering career to the next level? Emerson is seeking a highly motivated Senior Purchase Engineer to join the team in Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India. As a Purchase Professional, you will exhibit a strong work ethic and demonstrate exceptional proficiency in ensuring detailed and efficient procurement processes, enabling us to challenge in the global market. 
 In this Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be: Research and identify suitable suppliers to meet the part specification needs. Evaluate supplier performance based on quality, cost, and delivery reliability. Compare quotes from multiple suppliers to ensure pricing and negotiate at each stage like Item activation and project base order before fixing the sourcing rule. Collaborate with internal teams to understand purchasing requirements. Forecast demand for goods to fix effective procurement plans. Maintain accurate records of purchases, contracts, and supplier communications. Ensure compliance with company quality policies, legal regulations, and industry standards. Procurement of stores through Indigenous and foreign sources as required in accordance with the rules in force. Checking of requisitions/purchase indents. Selection of suppliers for issue of enquiries. Issuing enquiries/tenders and obtaining quotations. Analyzing quotations and bids etc, and preparation of comparative statement Collate purchase orders and purchase requisitions in order-to-order materials, goods and supplies. Review Excess inventories and order as required. Interact with the suppliers on a day-to-day basis and Review deliveries against the orders. Track the status of all open orders and Follow-up of purchase orders for delivery in due time. Verification and passing of suppliers bills to see that payments are made promptly. Ensuring all invoices are sent to accounts for payment process after good receipt. Resolve issues such as delays, defective products, or incorrect shipments. Maintenance of purchase records and vendor performance records/data. Ensure accuracy and timely Attribute study and setting in Oracle system. Effective co-ordination with Global Supply Chain (GSC) team across the world and align to their vendor management policies and consistent vendor performance. Align materials as per Oracle Demand date, synchronized receipt of materials & in turn support in meeting customer delivery dates. To review and set purchase policies on requirements of material from time to time and develop and maintain good buyer-seller (Vendor) relationship. Loading the foundry based on the RCCP tonnage allocated to each foundry as per GSC Guidelines. Analysis on Loading pattern based on Supplier performance of each vendor and surge loading of vendor based upon the project order flow in previous month. Submitting all transporter bills on time to Payable team and Tracking all transport payment, the NSDJ progress which is created to stock transfer of D-excess parts. Maintaining all Purchase metrics data - OTD, PPM and spent analysis report. Identifying the D-excess parts and allocating them to the current demand with approval from QC. Review and clearance of Vendor invoices for on time payment processing. 
 Who We Are: You act with a clear sense of ownership, build and deliver solutions that meet customer expectations, establish and maintain effective customer relationships and credit others for their contributions and accomplishments. 
 For This Role, You Will Need: Degree or equivalent experience or experience in Engineering and 5+ years Material Planning & Purchasing experience. Implementing an improved efficient sourcing strategy to avoid the lead time and other indirect cost. Well versed in MPS (Master Production Scheduling) and MRP (Material Requirement Planning). Candidate dedicated on achieving outcomes. Ability to travel across India and other world area on situation arise.
